::: {.atlas-colors-page}

Every place in the [Atlas of US Voting Blocs](atlas.qmd) and the [city atlas](atlas-cities.qmd) is colored on **one scale for every place**, so a bloc's color means the same thing in Maine as in Los Angeles.

Each bloc runs from blue to red by its **Trump 2024 two-party share** (2020 for Chicago, Salt Lake and Utah). Asian-plurality blocs run from teal to olive and Latino-plurality blocs from sand to orange instead, and five ethnically specific blocs take their own colors.

```{=html}
<figure class="ac-key" role="img" aria-label="Colour key: Trump 2024 two-party share, 0 to 100 percent, for white, Black and mixed; Asian-plurality; and Latino-plurality blocs">
  <div class="ac-key-row"><span>White / Black / mixed</span><i style="background:linear-gradient(to right,#120A4F,#1B34AA,#2389E6,#5CA9EB,#6FB1E9,#8DB4D8,#98B0C8,#A8B2C0,#BFBFC4,#CCA79C,#E98A66,#E07559,#D6604D,#C8493F,#A51426,#85081A,#67000D)"></i></div>
  <div class="ac-key-row"><span>Asian</span><i style="background:linear-gradient(to right,#1E5257,#1F698E,#0095A5,#00A6A1,#00AA9E,#37AC90,#47AA86,#56AB7F,#66B17E,#79A565,#98983E,#988E38,#968432,#927A2B,#85671F,#73601A,#615914)"></i></div>
  <div class="ac-key-row"><span>Latino</span><i style="background:linear-gradient(to right,#A5623F,#C37878,#CAAC8C,#D3BF86,#D8C381,#E0C572,#E3C266,#E9C35D,#F4CA5B,#FBBC3B,#FFAA00,#FF9E00,#FF9300,#FF8700,#F17100,#DD6C00,#CA6700)"></i></div>
  <div class="ac-key-row ac-key-ax"><span></span><b><em>0%</em><em>25%</em><em>50%</em><em>75%</em><em>100%</em></b></div>
  <figcaption>Trump share, 2024 (two-party)</figcaption></figure>

```

Every bloc starts on the top ramp, by its Trump 2024 two-party share; the Asian and Latino rows show the same ramp with the group's color fused in.

Bloc names and numbers are each fit's own: bloc 1 in one place has nothing to do with bloc 1 in another.

[&larr; Back to the atlas](atlas.qmd) &middot; [City atlas](atlas-cities.qmd)
